item.anvilsigil.desc: Passively repairs your armor and equipped items for an increased cost of XP
item.anvilsigil.desc2: I'm just a guy who repairs things.
item.aura.desc: Periodically deals damage to nearby hostile mobs based on your attack power.
item.aura.desc2: You radiate an air of danger.
item.bandofthedragon.desc: Grants immunity to all magic damage. Rarely dropped by the Ender Dragon.
item.baubleofliving.desc: A powerful charm containing the essence of life itself.
item.baubleofliving.desc2: Even death itself must take a step back.
item.beltofinsight.desc: Grants the wearer additional experience gain at the cost of luck.
item.beltofinsight.desc2: I'm quite fond of learning myself.
item.beltofluck.desc: Grants the wearer an enhanced luck stat at the cost of less experience gain.
item.berserkerspendant.desc: Attacking builds rage, increasing your outgoing damage.
item.berserkerspendant.desc2: Keep swinging or the fire fades.
item.chainreaction.desc: When your hit kills a mob, excess damage chains to nearby enemies.
item.combatstimulant.desc: Increases incoming healing to the wearer.
item.doubleabattery.desc: Provides immunity to lightning strikes as well as a chance to strike your enemies with lightning!
item.emberheartpendant.desc2: You draw strength from the flames themselves.
item.featherboots.desc: Provides Immunity to fall damage and prevents crop trampling.
item.featherboots.desc2: You know the saying, don't kill the messenger? Well, I'm a messenger, and you're a guy who's probably going to kill me.
item.finalgambit.desc: Reduces Health significantly, but provides a significant boost to damage and attack speed.
item.finalgambit.desc2: It's the final gambit.. dododo doo, dodododo doo
item.goldenheart.desc: Adds absorption hearts upon killing an enemy.
item.goldenheart.desc2: I will take your heart... to replace the one YOU took from ME!
item.leftovers.desc2: It's even better the second time!
item.moltenring.desc: Increases damage dealt to burning enemies.
item.moltenring.desc2: Strike while the iron is hot.
item.moltenring.name: Molten Ring
item.reflexloop.desc: Provides the wearer with a chance to mitigate projectile damage and add a random projectile item to inventory.
item.ringofresources.desc: Generates items when the user kills a mob. Only one of these rings can be equipped at a time.
item.ringofresources.desc2: And they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming.
item.turtleshellcharm.desc: Grants regeneration while blocking with a shield at the cost of slowness.
item.valorpendant.desc: On performing a critical hit, a random positive potion effect will be added to the wearer.
item.valorpendant.desc2: Fortune favors the brave.. or something like that.
item.vengeancecore.desc: On receiving damage, store a portion of it, and enhance your next attack with it.
